title: Sunset config variants and sanitize rollout history
creator: Ava Mitchell
description:
Summary: This ticket removes long-running config variants and stale rollout metadata that add complexity to routing and feature-gating. Work will consolidate multiple legacy flag variants into a single canonical schema, delete deprecated admin endpoints used by internal tooling (/v0/admin/*), and sanitize the rollout_history table to remove orphaned/ambiguous entries. Motivation: The current config surface has accumulated ~6 variant keys for the same rollout behaviors across hosted, dedicated, and private modes; this causes frequent conditional code paths in the router, inflates config fetch times, and complicates rollouts. Removing these variants will simplify kernel selection logic and reduce config fetch payloads, improving p50 latency for short requests and making future rollout tooling reliable.

Scope: 1) Map and collapse the following legacy keys into one canonical key (config.rollout_strategy): old names include rollout_v0, rroute, legacy_rollout_mode, compat_rollout, rollout_shim. 2) Remove /v0/admin/deploy-status and /v0/admin/flag-compat endpoints after migrating internal consumers. 3) Run a migration to sanitize rollout_history rows older than 12 months and with ambiguous schema_version fields; archive to s3 and mark removed to keep primary DB small. 4) Small client-side SDK compatibility shim for one release to avoid breaking external customers that accidentally call old admin APIs.

Non-goals: This ticket does NOT change rollout algorithms or rollout UI. It does not remove runtime fallback model variants; that will be handled in a follow-up once we have release signals.

Acceptance criteria: - All legacy config keys are mapped via a deployable server-side mapping layer and then removed from code paths. - No internal service references remain to the deprecated admin endpoints; automated checks pass. - rollout_history table size reduced and archived rows reachable for audits in S3. - Canary run shows no increase in 95th percentile latency for the router; token-level cost and error rate stay within 1% of baseline.

Migration plan and steps: 1) Add server-side mapping layer (router/config-service) that reads legacy keys and emits canonical config.rollout_strategy for 2 release cycles. 2) Deploy mapping behind a feature flag; run for 48 hours to collect metrics. 3) Notify internal consumers and run a small compatibility sweep (internal tooling owners list linked below). 4) Deploy DB migration in a single transaction-safe batch that moves rows older than 12 months with ambiguous schema_version to an S3 archive bucket (s3://redwood-archives/rollout_history/). 5) Deprecate endpoints: mark /v0/admin/* as read-only and add header warnings; then after 7 days, remove handlers and ensure clients fail cleanly with mapped codepaths. 6) Remove dead code across runtime and console, cut follow-up tickets for any manual cleanups.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests for mapping logic and endpoint 410 responses. - Integration test exercising router with a corpus of mixed old/new flags. - Canary: 5% of traffic for 48 hours with synthetic load verifying latency, error-rate, and config fetch payload sizes. - Post-migration smoke runbook and rollback: revert mapping flag, restore DB archive (keep backup), and reinstate endpoints if major regressions detected.

Observability and gates: - Dashboards updated: Config-API payload size, Router p50/p95 latency, rollout_history table growth, admin-endpoint 4xx/5xx. - Must maintain p95 router latency within 5% of baseline during canary; error-rate increase >1% triggers automatic rollback.

Docs and communication: - Add confluence doc with migration mapping and owner list: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLAT/Config+Variant+Consolidation. - Announce to #platform-eng and notify Solutions and SE teams to update any internal scripts. - Add deprecation note to internal API portal and public SDK changelog for one release.

Links to artifacts: - Draft migration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2514 (WIP) - Rollout history analysis notebook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c_analysis - Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLAT/Runbook+-+Sunset+Legacy+Config
